title: Moving your books into Celerp
summary: Bring a company over from another accounting system, from upload to the final check.

steps.text: Under {src}, choose {sys}, upload the export file it gives you and click {analyze}. Nothing is created yet.

Under {cov}, choose how much to bring. Full history recreates every transaction in the file. Cutover starts your books on a date you pick: balances on that date become opening balances, and open invoices, bills and stock are recreated.
Under {map}, choose where each account and setting from your file goes in Celerp. Celerp proposes a match for each one; check them before you go on.
Under {rev}, read the summary of what will be created, then start the import. The new company is created and the records move over.
Under {ver}, Celerp compares its totals with the totals in your file. Review each difference before you finish; you can also fix the file and upload it again.
